claims: The canonical full scripts/ci.sh passed all 13 stages on the exact clean candidate using verified XcodeGen 2.46.0 and the known-good dark iPhone simulator destination.
All 386 full CI test executions passed with no failures, skips, or expected failures: 19 golden iOS contracts, 124 Watch unit, 163 phone unit, 62 Watch UI, and 18 phone UI.

The full run includes passing idle picker entry then project-tap immediate start, paused entry without resuming, warm return from Controls and Run to elapsed preserving paused duration, and legacy/stale project routes.
The repaired largest-text rectangular widget matrices passed strict original content bounds, exact padded-wrapper checks, localization expansion, privacy, and full accessibility audits.
The repaired phone active timer and completion accessibility audits passed in full CI and in focused dark and light appearance runs without adding an audit exemption.

Five focused existing tests passed on the smallest 40 mm Watch for immediate start under combined adaptations, timer controls, custom goal, long project names, and summary; the repaired header was visually verified.
Source generation, agent-control, privacy, localization, all four joint builds, release fixture exclusion, and unsigned release-product provenance checks passed.

Independent native visual review found no blocking fit issue in ordinary Watch surfaces or phone ordinary/largest text light/dark captures; image locators and digests are recorded in the visual index.
Final source commit/tree and clean working tree were verified after CI exited successfully and before releasing build/simulator use and source freeze; no source repair was made by this verifier.
limitations: This is engineering/simulator evidence for exact source version 0.1.0 build 4; it does not certify a later version-only commit or signed archive.
App-hosted widget rendering and DEBUG URL-runtime triggers do not prove WidgetKit delivery or physical Watch behavior.
The initial old-simulator XCTest host failure and prior 7e880 layout/audit failures remain separate preserved attempts.
A focused light test-without-building attempt failed before the expected fixture appeared; its canonical test retry on unchanged repaired source passed both audits.
No signing, export, upload, App Review, public release, or physical-device gate is closed by this receipt.
